boundaries: The declared harness allowlist and nothing else.
Evaluator, heldout seeds, reward implementation, evidence gates, protected task files.
Candidate code runs under a declared sandbox and network policy, in a candidate-private workspace.
Heldout seeds, opened only for the frozen winner.
hypothesis: Measured Craftax performance is limited by the CodeAct harness — observation encoding, tool wiring, retry logic — more than by the instruction text, so a real code patch should beat a prompt rewrite.

state that is written to durable storage and survives a restart

OHCO HARNESS CANDIDATE — a real code patch, admitted before it costs environment spend


┌───────── BASE + SCOPE ─────────┐                ┌───── ISOLATED WORKSPACE ─────┐            ╔════════ ADMISSION GATE ════════╗
│ repository · full commit sha   │                │ candidate-private checkout   │            ║ build                          ║
│ allowed subtree (allowlist)    │                │ declared sandbox             │            ║ typecheck                      ║
│ parent candidate id            │                │ declared network policy      │            ║ unit tests                     ║
│ patch digest sha256:…          │  materialise   │ apply patch                  │ build+test ║ integration tests              ║
│ code size / file / path caps   │───────────────▶│                              │───────────▶║ environment QA                 ║
│ explicit harness objective     │                │ rollback proof and           │            ║                                ║
│ immutable container + source   │                │ workspace-integrity check    │            ║ a broken candidate is          ║
│ bundle digests                 │                │                              │            ║ rejected here, not scored      ║
└────────────────────────────────┘                └──────────────────────────────┘            ╚════════════════════════════════╝



┌──── BASELINE vs CANDIDATE ─────┐                ┌── PINNED CRAFTAX CONTAINER ──┐
│ matched seeds only             │                │ fixed seeds                  │
│ patch provenance retained      │    evidence    │ evidence gates               │  admitted
│ improvement hypothesis is      │◀───────────────│ traces · rewards · steps     │◀───────────
│ resolved honestly              │                │ achievements · errors        │
│                                │                │                              │
└────────────────────────────────┘                └──────────────────────────────┘

The candidate never sees the evaluator, the heldout seeds, the reward implementation or the evidence gates.
panels.caption: Every stage a patch must survive before a single rollout is spent on it, and the provenance that follows it through.
notes: Rejecting broken candidates before environment spend is what makes a code-editing optimizer affordable at all.
The MAPO harness lane implements exactly this shape end to end: patch ops → workspace → py_compile → contract test → rollout, with a unified diff and a patch digest in the receipt.

WHAT OHCO MAY AND MAY NOT TOUCH


┌───── WRITABLE (allowlisted subtree) ─────┐                ┏━━━━━ PROTECTED (refusal, not warning) ━━━━━┓
│ CodeAct harness / library surface        │                ┃ evaluator implementation                   ┃
│ observation encoding                     │                ┃ heldout seeds and splits                   ┃
│ tool and action wiring                   │    refused     ┃ reward implementation                      ┃
│ planning and retry logic                 │───────────────▶┃ evidence gates                             ┃
│ prompt scaffolding inside the harness    │                ┃ protected task files                       ┃
│ configuration the harness owns           │                ┃ the benchmark itself                       ┃
│                                          │                ┃                                            ┃
└──────────────────────────────────────────┘                ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛


┌────── WHY THIS IS THE WHOLE POINT ───────┐                A patch that touches a protected path is rejected
│ a candidate that can edit the benchmark  │                at admission, before any container is launched, so
│ will edit the benchmark                  │                the refusal costs nothing and leaves a receipt.
│                                          │
└──────────────────────────────────────────┘
panels.caption: The allowlist is the safety property. A candidate that can edit the benchmark will eventually edit the benchmark.
notes: Refusal happens at admission, so it costs nothing and still leaves a receipt.

subtitle: Optimizing the harness rather than the prompt: real code patches, admitted by build and test before they are allowed to cost environment spend.
title: OHCO
verdict: Specified. Not proven: no OHCO Craftax lane was run in this campaign.
why: OHCO is a private hosted compatibility lane in the public package today. The candidate contract and the protected-surface rules below are design, and the one place the pattern has actually been executed is MAPO's harness lane on DungeonGrid.
